meta.scoring: RSL Fantasy rules (goals FWD/MID +5 DEF/GK +6, CS 5/4/1, saves /2, micro-stats: tackles/def actions/shots/passes/big chances)
meta.team_strength_source: GoalIQ Dixon-Coles, SPL results (ESPN) ['2425', '2526', '2627'] incl. 45 played 26/27 matches from the RSL Fantasy feed - goals-based fit
meta.attack_basis: Realized goal/assist rates per 90 (shrunk to position priors). No free per-player xG feed exists for the SPL; this is NOT an xG-based projection and public copy must not claim it is.
meta.minutes_basis: Season-aggregate minutes only (the RSL API has no per-round history or starts). Two-mode estimate (start ~86min / cameo ~20min) + depth normalization to a typical XI; confidence is 'med' at best. Players with no RSL history use price-order role priors measured on FPL data (0.47/0.21/0.05), an uncalibrated transfer, stated here deliberately.

model_squad.note: Strongest squad the model found (greedy search with local swaps), not a proven optimum. RSL rules: 100.0 budget, 2 GK / 5 DEF / 5 MID / 3 FWD, max 3 per club.
